svg.text: Customer Success Manager at Civic Tech Collective

text.tspan: I coached a practice focused on effort cues,
not highlight plays.
We celebrated hustle plays louder than
highlight plays.
Appreciate the people who made this easier.
Joy is a performance factor, not a
distraction.
I learned the opposing coach's name and the
tone of the rivalry softened.
Show up for the boring midweek games too.
Practice ended with a habit drill that looked
boring and mattered.
Rest and recovery belong in the training plan.
The call was bad. The response from the
players was professional.
Show up for the boring midweek games too.
Film review was five minutes of specifics, not
a rant.
Effort is a skill you can reinforce.
A bench player changed the energy when they
entered. Notice that.
Being a good teammate outlasts any single
season.
We rotated playing time more fairly and
chemistry improved.
Sportsmanship is a public practice.
We rotated playing time more fairly and
chemistry improved.
Sideline behavior is part of the coaching
curriculum.
We lost, and the kids still wanted ice cream.
Correct priorities.
Teams remember who stayed steady after
mistakes.

Respect officials even when the call stings.
